name: collected > settleable on a MIXED invoice: a credit on the INELIGIBLE line must not raise the eligible line's commission

expected.workings: THE REGIME NINE FIXTURES AND FORTY MUTANTS NEVER REACHED. Every earlier partners fixture sits at collected == settleable, because the spike measured only that regime and the fixtures were written from the spike (EXECUTION-LESSONS 2.93). Here they diverge, and the divergence is ORDINARY: a credit note moves `settleable` the instant it is issued, while `collected` does not move until a refund VOUCHER IS PAID. The whole 156000 is still in the drawer. The credit is on the PHARMACY line, a category this agreement pays NOTHING on, so the eligible base must not move at all. CREDIT-AWARE: eligibleBase = 100000 - 0 = 100000 (the pharmacy line is not eligible and contributes nothing either way). settleable = 156000 - 56000 = 100000. collected = 156000 - 0 = 156000. NOTE collected (156000) EXCEEDS settleable (100000) -- the ratio is 1.56, not 1. UNCLAMPED: divHalfUp(100000 x 156000, 100000) = 156000, i.e. the base becomes the WHOLE invoice including the pharmacy the agreement does not pay for, and target = percentAmount(156000, 1000) = 15600 -- a 56% rise in the commission on a consultation nobody touched. CLAMPED (09a DD1, owner ruling SERVICE DELIVERED): targetBase = min(156000, eligibleBase 100000) = 100000, target = percentAmount(100000, 1000) = 10000. The consultation was delivered and is still owed for, so the commission on it is unchanged -- which is the whole point. prior 10000 means the delta is 0: the ledger already says 10000 and crediting an ineligible line gives it no reason to move.
